_what: What this browser answers when the person's own computer relays a request to it (src/computer-relay.mjs, native-host/browser-relay.json): `tools` names the function that answers each tool id (src/browser-runs.mjs). `read_page` is how a page is read: opened in a window of its own that is not brought forward, read once loaded and `settle_ms` has passed, at most `most_seconds` in all and `max_text` characters, then closed. `act` is how long an action settles and how much of the page is read back. Every word an AI reads is under `words`.

words.needs_url: Send the page's address as url (http or https).
words.not_read: This browser opened {url} but could not read it: {error}
words.too_slow: {url} did not finish loading in this browser within {seconds} seconds.
words.needs_steps: Send the steps to do as steps: a list of { do, target, ... } (see the actions this browser knows).
